name: confirm_trial_cancel
description: INTERNAL — invoked ONLY by the cancel-trial confirmation widget on an explicit user click of 'Cancel auto-renewal'. Do NOT call this tool yourself; to cancel the trial's auto-renewal use `cancel_trial_auto_renewal` instead. Stops the trial's auto-renewal (cancel_at_period_end) — trial access and remaining credits stay until the trial ends.
